# Contract: Export Action

<!-- Generated by Spec-Kit /speckit.plan | Session: a0048076-0ae1-42e8-b25c-9d53f1b17c55 | Date: 2026-01-26 -->

## Overview

Exports metrics to CSV or JSON format for external analysis (FR-006).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `-Action` | string | Yes | - | Must be "Export" |
| `-Format` | string | No | "CSV" | Export format: "CSV" or "JSON" |
| `-OutputPath` | string | No | Auto-generated | Output file path |
| `-IncludeArchives` | switch | No | false | Include all archived sessions |
| `-FeatureBranch` | string | No | - | Filter archives by branch |

## Behavior

1. Load active session (or archives if `-IncludeArchives`)
2. Transform invocations to flat structure
3. Export based on format:
   - **CSV**: Standard comma-separated with headers
   - **JSON**: Formatted array of invocation objects
4. Save to output path
5. Output success message with file location

## CSV Schema

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `Timestamp` | string | ISO 8601 timestamp |
| `Phase` | string | Spec-Kit phase name |
| `FeatureBranch` | string | Git branch name |
| `Agent` | string | Agent identifier |
| `Model` | string | AI model used |
| `TaskId` | string | Task identifier |
| `Category` | string | Task category |
| `Status` | string | Completion status |
| `Tokens` | integer | Tokens consumed |
| `DurationMs` | integer | Duration in ms |
| `DurationSec` | number | Duration in seconds |
| `IsParallel` | boolean | Was parallel execution |
| `ParallelGroupId` | string | Parallel group ID |
| `Description` | string | Task description |

## Output Naming

Default naming pattern:
- Single session: `metrics-export-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.csv`
- With archives: `metrics-export-all-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.csv`

## Example

```powershell
# Export current session to CSV
.\agent-metrics.ps1 -Action Export -Format CSV

# Export to specific path
.\agent-metrics.ps1 -Action Export -Format CSV -OutputPath "./my-metrics.csv"

# Export all archives as JSON
.\agent-metrics.ps1 -Action Export -Format JSON -IncludeArchives

# Export specific branch archives
.\agent-metrics.ps1 -Action Export -Format CSV -IncludeArchives -FeatureBranch "001-feature"
```

```text

```

```csv

2026-01-26T10:07:45.456Z,implement,001-feature,test-engineer,sonnet,a620109,testing,completed,30000,90000,90.0,TRUE,pg-20260126-100300,Write PaywallController tests
```

## Preconditions

- Active session exists (or archives if `-IncludeArchives`)

## Postconditions

- Export file created at output path
- File is valid CSV or JSON

## Error Handling

| Error | Behavior |
|-------|----------|
| No metrics to export | Exit with "No metrics found to export" |
| Invalid output path | Exit with "Cannot write to: {path}" |
| Invalid format | PowerShell ValidateSet rejects |
